svg.title: Shiroi Youso — Confluence of Five. Fable proposal — 2026-10-04 batch rebalance / Fire + Lightning classification / forked tree.
svg.desc: 10 skills, 4 purchases, one Advanced Art maximum. Fivefold Kindling forks into Gathering Palm then Divine Convergence, or Charred Current then White Immolation. Pale Vessel forks into Gale Bulwark then Eye of the Tempest, or Rising Currents then White Maelstrom. No paths converge. Bonuses apply to matching supported tags on all Fire and Lightning jutsu.

compounding 35% five-element self Increase Damage Given buffs on Fire Release and Wind Release, a third on the injected Voltari for Earth, Lightning and Water hits; two 35% five-element exposures on Fire Release and Element Divine's area, raised only at the Foundation)","secondary":"Burst and burn on the marked target (Damage on Lightning Release 40 and Element Divine 45 EP, held to +2; Afterburn on the same two casts, 35% and 30%)","tertiary":"Defensive control (self Decrease Damage Taken on Wind Release and Earth Release; static Heal on Water Release)","rationale":"Eleven supported rows sit on six casts. The highest-leverage rows are the paired five-element percentage rows: two self Increase Damage Given buffs and two exposures, each multiplying every five-element hit in the two rounds after its cast, injected children included, and compounding with one another. The tree therefore splits by who gains. Fivefold Kindling marks the target (+2% exposure, the tree's only exposure bonus) and asks \"How do I finish the target I mark: strike it down with my own blows, or burn it so every hit on it feeds the fire?\": a self-buff setup with a controlled +2 Damage payoff (Divine Convergence) or Afterburn that allies' hits feed too (White Immolation). Pale Vessel strengthens the caster (\"How do I strengthen myself: strike harder or stand firmer?\") and forks into the compounding self damage buffs (White Maelstrom) and the compounding self Decrease Damage Taken buffs with Water Release's Heal (Eye of the Tempest); both pairs stop at +8%. Flat Damage stops at +2 because the kit's Damage rows are 40 and 45 EP: +5 would lift Lightning Release to 45 and Element Divine to 50. Potency scope is multi-element pending director review: Fire and Lightning (RUL-2026-10-03-005)."},"nodes":[{"id":"01","name":"Fivefold Kindling","category":"Foundation","cost":1,"parents":[],"modifiers":[{"tag":"increasedamagetaken","flat":2,"display_role":"ENEMY DEBUFF"}],"flavor":"Five elements, one white spark. Replaced: Tidal Mending (+3% Heal) and Pull of the Undertow (+5% Increase Damage Taken, +2% Decrease Damage Taken), a heal-gated exposure that did not fit a defensive Foundation, by Rising Currents (+2% Increase Damage Given) and White Maelstrom (+4%). White Immolation drops its +2% Increase Damage Taken. Bedrock and Tide's +2% Heal and Tidal Mending's +3% Heal are removed; Eye of the Tempest's +3% Increase Damage Given becomes +5% Heal (Heal maximum unchanged at +5%). Second pass: Eye of the Tempest's Decrease Damage Taken goes +5% \u2192 +3% (route +10% \u2192 +8%; next note). Final review: the setup, first Opened to the Elements (+3% Increase Damage Taken), becomes Gathering Palm (then +3% self Increase Damage Given), because White Immolation's natural fourth bought that exposure on Element Divine's area on top of its Afterburn and took over Divine Convergence's niche (R1). Consistency pass: Gathering Palm +3% \u2192 +2%, because Fivefold Kindling + Gathering Palm + Pale Vessel + Rising Currents reached +7% Increase Damage Given with no Advanced Art, within 1 point of White Maelstrom's +8% (R9\u2032(b)); now +6%. Increase Damage Given: the double-buff window goes \u00d71.35\u00b2 \u2248 \u00d71.82 \u2192 \u00d71.43\u00b2 \u2248 \u00d72.04, about what Divine Convergence with Pale Vessel gives its Damage rows in the same window (\u00d71.39\u00b2 \u00d7 42/40 \u2248 \u00d72.03). Decrease Damage Taken: incoming with both buffs live goes \u00d70.65\u00b2 \u2248 \u00d70.42 \u2192 \u00d70.57\u00b2 \u2248 \u00d70.32, \u00d70.769 of unmodified (+10% would reach \u00d70.55\u00b2 \u2248 \u00d70.30, \u00d70.716). Blood-Enchanted Eyes' Deathless Vitality (\u00d70.747) runs 2 + 3 + 5 over two rows, but one is a 15% row on a 60 AP strike; here both are 35% buffs on 40 AP casts, so the tree holds them to the same test as the damage buffs. Exposure stays at the Foundation's +2% (two rows, team-wide) and Afterburn at +10% (the burns do not compound; they share the 60% per-hit cap).","Filters (SOURCE_MECHANICS \u00a73/\u00a73b): the Increase Damage Given and Increase Damage Taken rows list the five elements with no stat filter, so each multiplies five-element damage only, by 1 + power/100 per matching row: the kit's two Damage rows, the five injected children and any other five-element hit; element-less hits get ratio 0. The Decrease Damage Taken rows list all four stat types and no element: every non-pierce hit. Two pairs share three nodes and differ only in the capstone. On the target, 01+02+03+04 and 01+02+04+05 trade +2 Damage for +7% Afterburn: on the caster's Lightning Release against a target carrying Fire Release's mark and Element Divine's burn they come out even (42 \u00d7 1.33 \u2248 56 against 40 \u00d7 1.40 = 56); the +2 wins in the opener and while both burns are capped at 60%, the Afterburn on allies' hits. No fourth adds exposure: White Immolation with Pale Vessel or Gathering Palm leaves Element Divine's area at Fivefold Kindling's 37%. On the caster, 06+07+09 then chooses between Eye of the Tempest, about \u221210% incoming (\u00d70.60\u00b2 = \u00d70.36 \u2192 \u00d70.57\u00b2 \u2248 \u00d70.32 with both buffs live) plus 100 HP per Water Release cast, and White Maelstrom, about +6% output (\u00d71.39\u00b2 \u2248 \u00d71.93 \u2192 \u00d71.43\u00b2 \u2248 \u00d72.04). White Maelstrom with Fivefold Kindling and Divine Convergence with Pale Vessel hold the same Foundations, so exposure and Decrease Damage Taken cancel. On hits from Fire and Lightning jutsu (both Damage rows, Voltari, Great Fire Annihilation, Rising Water Slicer) they are about even with both self buffs live, White Maelstrom about 1% ahead (42 \u00d7 1.39\u00b2 \u2248 81.1 against 40 \u00d7 1.43\u00b2 \u2248 81.8; 47 \u00d7 1.39\u00b2 \u2248 90.8 against 45 \u00d7 1.43\u00b2 \u2248 92.0), and Divine Convergence leads with one live (\u00d71.46 against \u00d71.43) or none (\u00d71.05), because the +2 is element-wide. White Maelstrom leads on other five-element hits inside the windows (\u00d71.43\u00b2 / 1.39\u00b2 \u2248 \u00d71.06: Planetary Devastation, Great Vacuum Bullet, off-kit Earth, Wind or Water jutsu) and in Voltari's three-buff window. trimming the route to +5% gives \u2248 \u00d71.17 and, to keep every capstone-free build more than 1 point below it (R9\u2032(b)), needs a shape such as 1/1/3 with Gathering Palm at +1%); DQ-H (self/enemy root axis: Fivefold Kindling is the target root at +2% Increase Damage Taken and Pale Vessel the caster root at +2% Increase Damage Given and +2% Decrease Damage Taken, in place of the pre-batch offence root, Fivefold Kindling at +2% Increase Damage Given and +2% Increase Damage Taken, and defence root, Bedrock and Tide at +2% Decrease Damage Taken and +2% Heal; node count unchanged at 10. Voltari is in scope, so its 35% self buff (Earth, Lightning, Water) is a third compounding row on those hits (\u00d71.43\u00b3 \u2248 \u00d72.92 against \u00d72.46 unmodified, \u00d71.19; R3's +5% would give \u00d71.40\u00b3 \u2248 \u00d72.74). Kit reason: the third row exists only in the two rounds after Voltari is cast, which is only possible in the two rounds after Lightning Release; it skips Fire hits; and neither kit Damage row collects it (Lightning Release is on its cooldown 7, Element Divine is Fire, Voltari never buffs its own hit). Three rows reach only Planetary Devastation, Rising Water Slicer and off-kit Earth, Lightning or Water jutsu, about once per Lightning Release cooldown and only when Fire Release and Wind Release were cast to overlap; the route's ordinary hits see two rows.","Eye of the Tempest stops at +8% Decrease Damage Taken on two compounding 35% rows (both live \u00d70.57\u00b2 \u2248 \u00d70.32, \u00d70.769 of unmodified), slightly lighter than Blood-Enchanted Eyes' Deathless Vitality (\u00d70.747: +10% on a 35% and a 15% row, plus a Decrease Damage Given rider). Eye of the Tempest at +5% (route +10%) would be \u00d70.716, past that anchor on two strong rows, and a director question (R11).","Exposure is held at Fivefold Kindling's +2% on purpose: Divine Convergence's setup is a self buff, so no fourth purchase stacks exposure with White Immolation's Afterburn on Element Divine's area. Gathering Palm and Rising Currents raise the same two self buffs by +2% under different Foundations: neither is a legal fourth for the other's route, so they never stack on one capstone (not a twin, R4) and they set up different payoffs (Divine Convergence's flat strikes, White Maelstrom's buffs); bought together with no Advanced Art (01+02+06+09) they reach +6%, two points under White Maelstrom's +8% (R9\u2032(b)). Two of fourteen full builds are numerically dominated: 01+02+06+09 by White Maelstrom's 01+06+09+10, and 01+02+04+05 by 01+04+05+06 (Pale Vessel matches Gathering Palm's +2% and adds Decrease Damage Taken); every node still sits in a non-dominated build. Two pairs of full builds also tie on every tag total (01+02+06+07 and 01+06+07+09; 01+02+04+06 and 01+04+06+09), because Gathering Palm and Rising Currents now both add +2% to the same buffs.","The two native burns already pass the 60% per-hit Afterburn cap together, so White Immolation's value depends on alternating Lightning Release and Element Divine.","Divine Convergence and White Immolation share Fivefold Kindling and trade on paper: on the caster's Lightning Release against Fire Release's mark and one burn they come out about even; Divine Convergence leads in the opener and on hits that land while both burns are capped, White Immolation on allies' hits (\u00d71.92 against \u00d71.82 with Charred Current). Divine Convergence with Pale Vessel and White Maelstrom with Fivefold Kindling are close: within about 1% on Fire and Lightning hits with both self buffs live (White Maelstrom slightly ahead), Divine Convergence ahead with one or none (the +2 is element-wide), White Maelstrom ahead on other five-element hits inside the windows (\u00d71.06) and in Voltari's three-buff window. Rotation and uptime were not simulated. g.text: Foundations support. Hidden Arts focus. Advanced Arts define.
1 BP each · Acquire points with silver
FIRE + LIGHTNING POTENCY CLASSIFICATION · DIRECTOR REVIEW
Bonuses apply to matching supported tags on all Fire and Lightning jutsu. Combat scopes stay unchanged.
Finish a path in 3 purchases. Spend your fourth on support or a sibling Hidden Art.
Any two Advanced Arts require at least 5 points. Your limit is 4.
Each skill purchased once · Only your current bloodline unlocks · No converging paths
Examples are choices, not locked presets. Advanced Arts are optional.
Eye of the Tempest path + Rising Currents
IDG: Increase Damage Given · IDT: Increase Damage Taken · DDT: Decrease Damage Taken · AB: Afterburn · HEAL: Heal
FINAL TAG VALUES ON THE SHIROI YOUSO KIT
Jutsu level 25 · main-tree bonuses and bloodline passives excluded
Static bonuses: a 35% tag with +5% becomes 40%. A 40 EP jutsu with +5 Damage becomes 45EP.
Afterburn is an enemy debuff: while it lasts, damage the target takes adds Afterburn damage at the debuff percentage (60% cap per hit).
On a static Heal effect each +1% Heal adds 1 heal power, which heals 10 HP per tick (display conflict under review).
Proposed behavior: needs a jutsu-classification potency resolver. The current resolver matches each effect's own elements.
14 legal four-skill allocations · 4 Advanced Arts available · Combat tuning remains experimental
Fable proposal — 2026-10-04 batch rebalance / Fire + Lightning classification / forked tree
